banks_movements_one_source.name: banks_movements_one_source
banks_movements_one_source.value:
(CASE WHEN "banks_movements"."sale_payment_id" IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END
         + CASE WHEN "banks_movements"."entry_payment_id" IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END
         + CASE WHEN "banks_movements"."expense_payment_id" IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) <= 1

banks_movements_amount_sign.name: banks_movements_amount_sign
banks_movements_amount_sign.value:
CASE "banks_movements"."type"
            WHEN 'cobro_venta'  THEN "banks_movements"."amount" > 0
            WHEN 'pago_entrada' THEN "banks_movements"."amount" < 0
            WHEN 'pago_gasto'   THEN "banks_movements"."amount" < 0
            WHEN 'prestamo'     THEN "banks_movements"."amount" > 0
            WHEN 'retiro'       THEN "banks_movements"."amount" < 0
            ELSE "banks_movements"."amount" <> 0
          END

banks_movements_concept_required.name: banks_movements_concept_required
banks_movements_concept_required.value: "banks_movements"."type"::text <> 'movimiento' OR ("banks_movements"."concept" IS NOT NULL AND btrim("banks_movements"."concept") <> '')
